name: @w6w-apps/fillout
description: Read Fillout forms and their submissions, import submissions, and subscribe webhooks, over the Fillout REST API v1, with a poll trigger for new form submissions.

w6w.longDescription:
Fillout is a form builder, and this app covers its entire public API: reading which forms exist, pulling their submissions, creating a submission programmatically, and subscribing a webhook so a workflow hears about new responses as they arrive.

Because that's the whole surface Fillout currently exposes, there's no larger feature set held back — a workflow gets everything a form owner could automate today. Submissions come through with any file uploads already resolved to URLs, so downstream steps can fetch an attachment without needing a separate storage flow. Deleting a submission or a webhook is available too, each safe to retry without creating a duplicate.

What isn't here is anything Fillout itself doesn't support well from outside its own dashboard: there's no API for a form's design, and Fillout's third-party OAuth path is still gated behind vendor approval, so this app authenticates with a straightforward account-level key instead — simpler to set up and just as capable for reading and moving submission data.

Poll trigger: New Submission, for a form you choose.
